sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr.G.Gajendiran, learned counsel for petitioners and Mr.A.Damodaran, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for first respondent.
3.

The petitioners, who have been arrayed as A2 and A4, took a specific stand that no final report was filed in this case and the Court below has straightaway assigned calendar case number viz.,
C.C.No.242 of 2019 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Criminal Original Petition No.3801 of 2024 on an application that was filed under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C.

In the light of the above submission,
this Court passed the following order on 27.02.2024:
"The learned Additional Public Prosecutor seeks for some time to take instructions in this case.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the Court below had ordered an application filed under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C and no final report was filed in this case under Section 173(2) of Cr.P.C and in spite of the same, a calender case has been taken cognizance.
Even thereafter, there has been absolutely no progress in this case.
3. The learned Judicial Magistrate-I Alandur is directed to submit a report before this Court.

4. Post this case under the same caption on 12.03.2024.
5.
Registry is directed to follow up and get the report before the next date of hearing."

4. Pursuant to the above order, a report has been received from the learned Judicial Magistrate,
Alandur.
For proper appreciation, the relevant portions are extracted hereunder:

"I most humbly and respectfully submit that this court has taken cognizance on 09.04.2019 as C.C.No.242/2019 in Cr.No.80/2014, U/Sec.406, 420 IPC and the summons has been issued to Accused persons namely Nirmal Uthamchand,
Narayanalal, Meena and Rekha.

On 21.10.2021 the summons has been served to A2 Narayan Lal vs The Inspector Of Police on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61524404/

https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Criminal Original Petition No.3801 of 2024 A3
has not appeared and hence Bailable Warrant has been issued against her and since service of summon to A1 was Returned as no such person, Fresh summon to A1 was ordered.
Till date the warrant against A3 is not executed and since process for A1 is not paid, the summon has not been served to A1.

I most humbly and respectfully submit that your lordship, this case is pending at the stage of execution of Bailable Warrant against A3 (Meena) and for service of summon to A1 (Nirmal Uthamchand)."
5.

In the light of the above report, it is clear that final report is available before the Court below and presently, bailable warrant is pending against A3 and summon is yet to be served on A1.
6.
In view of the above report, there is no question of quashing the First Information Report in this case.
It is left open to the petitioner to apply for the certified copy of the final report before the Court below and the Court below shall furnish a certified copy of the final report to the petitioners.
It is left open to the petitioners to work out their remedy in accordance with law.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Criminal Original Petition No.3801 of 2024 This Criminal Original Petition is disposed of in the above terms.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
